body.cap: Johnny Byungjoon Min, CEO of dob Studio (left), introduces the company’s “Live Styler” to visitors at CES 2026 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: dob Studio Inc. (Co-CEOs Johnny Byungjoon Min and Youngjune Kwon) participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.

dob Studio is a Korean startup developing AI-based real-time face transformation and virtual human technologies, aiming to innovate the content creation environment. By combining AI, computer vision, and video processing technologies, the company delivers solutions designed to significantly streamline the content production journey.

Previously, dob Studio drew industry attention by commercializing its proprietary real-time face transformation engine and multi-style generation technology, “Multi-Stylizer.” The solution has been recognized as an immediately deployable AI tool across broadcasting, advertising, live streaming, and education, enabling creators and enterprises to produce high-quality content more efficiently, according to the company.

At CES 2026 Unveiled, dob Studio showcased “Live Styler,” an advanced real-time face transformation solution. Live Styler converts the face of an on-screen subject into various styles in real time, reducing the need for labor-intensive post-production and thereby cutting production time and costs.
Live Styler is available in SaaS, SDK, and API formats, enabling production studios to seamlessly integrate it into their existing workflows and systems.

With strong scalability and flexibility for immediate use across entertainment, advertising, and content platforms, Live Styler has been recognized for its practical value as an AI content creation solution. At this year’s CES, it was selected as an Innovation Award honoree in the Content & Entertainment category.

body.cap: Jay Kennedy Markus, a reporter for AVING News, experiences a Live Styler demo at the dob Studio booth. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Looking ahead, dob Studio plans to further advance face-specific AI technologies, including virtual character creation, de-aging, and virtual human restoration. The company has already carried out multiple projects in Korea’s education and content sectors and is reportedly conducting proofs of concept with various partners in broadcasting and video production environments.

Internationally, dob Studio continues to expand its network and pursue technology demos and partnership discussions in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, and the United Arab Emirates, with plans to begin gradual market entry starting in Southeast Asia.

A dob Studio representative said, “CES 2026 Unveiled was an ideal opportunity to reintroduce the competitiveness of Live Styler, which has been recognized with an Innovation Award, to the global tech industry.” The representative added, “At the main CES exhibition, we plan to intensify our promotional efforts and explore new partnerships across North America, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.”

The representative continued, “We aim to secure early revenue and references in the fast-growing Southeast Asian market, then leverage those results to expand step by step into Japan and the Middle East.” The representative concluded, “Through collaboration with global companies, content platforms, and investors, dob Studio will broaden the reach of real-time AI content creation technologies and accelerate its growth into a next-generation content infrastructure company.”

Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the leading CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held before the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and significant technology industry stakeholders in one place.
